summary.description: Two or three sentences on what this change does and where its risk sits. Goes at the top of the posted review.

notes.description: Anything about the run rather than the code: a lens that returned nothing, a skill that would not load, coverage you believe is missing. Reported to the author as caveats, so say what you could not check.

lens_health.description: One entry per lens you dispatched, including any that failed or returned nothing.

ok.description: False when the lens errored, could not load its skill, or returned an unusable response.

status.description: Whether an earlier run already posted a comment describing this same defect. Only 'new' findings get posted. When in doubt say 'new': a repeated comment is a small cost, a suppressed finding is one nobody sees.

existing_comment_url.description: Required when status is 'already-reported': the url of the earlier comment that covers it.

found_by.description: Every lens that independently reported this defect. More than one entry means it was deduplicated, which is corroboration worth surfacing.

line.description: The single most specific line the finding is about.

end_line.description: Only for a genuine multi-line range.

in_diff.description: False when this line is not part of the reviewed diff. Report it anyway — it gets moved into the review body rather than dropped.

body.description: The problem and the fix. When several lenses described it, keep what each added rather than flattening to the shortest version.
